svg.title: macOS · Shape-mation · builder · Mode step (sheet) · 760×680
svg.desc: Mirrors App/Shapemation/ShapemationBuilderView.swift — ShapemationModeView (the builder's Mode step: the question, three mode cards, planSummary, the pinned Next · timing bar) inside ShapemationBuilderView's NavigationStack, presented from ShapemationHomeView as the Mac's 560-wide sheet over the Create tab. Drawn 2026-09-20, mirrored from the Debug build on the tram clone (Steven's KEEP library, 164 tram projects) with LL_SHAPEMATION=build LL_CHIPS=tram, the Rectangle family, Any aspect, 83 of 83 projects picked; capture builder.mode.png + its AX dump. GEOMETRY (1 unit = 1 pt): the 760×680 window, a 32 pt title bar (traffic lights at y 36, the title 'Create' 13/600 beside them), the Create page dimmed 17 % under the sheet. The sheet is 560 wide at x 120, its top at y 52 right under the title bar, and 679.5 tall — TALLER than the window, so its foot overhangs the window's bottom edge by 31.5 pt (as captured: every builder step is ~680 tall on the Mac, the home sheet ~745). Nav bar 47.5 pt white with a hairline: a 29 pt accent circle with a white chevron.left (Back) at (144, 76) and the step title 13/700 at x 168.5. Content on LL.screenBackground, 16 pt padding: the question 17/600 (baseline 132); THREE MODE CARDS (llCard radius 16, 527 wide, 83 tall, 12 apart at y 147.5 / 242.5 / 337.5; each a Button, 14 pt padding): a 34 pt icon tile (radius 9; accent with a white 17/600 symbol when chosen, accent-12 % with an accent symbol otherwise — rectangle.stack · crop · viewfinder.rectangular), the title 16/600 with the summary 13 secondary under it (wrapping to two lines at this width), and at the trailing edge checkmark.circle.fill 22 pt accent (chosen) or circle 22 pt secondary-50 %. Copy is the app's: 'Stack, fit in frame — The canvas holds every photo. Each lands on top of the last, the shape locked in place; the black table shows until it is covered.' · 'Stack, crop to fill — The same stack, cropped to what every photo covers. No black — but one off-centre shape crops everyone.' · 'Output frame — Pick the frame; the face is put at a chosen size and place in every photo; what won't fill it is flagged.' (the third card is docs/shapemation/output-frame.md §6, code first 2026-09-19). Under the cards planSummary 12 secondary: 'Canvas 3274×4924 holds every photo; the shape is 398 px across.' (stack mode over the 83 rectangle projects). OUTPUT FRAME CHOSEN (builder.mode.frame.png, desc-only — same layout, the third card checked): the line reads 'Frame 1920×1080; the shape is 270 px across; 82 photos flagged — see Output.' The crop-mode empty-intersection warning ('These photos share no common area once the shape is locked — crop mode has nothing to show. Pick fewer, or use stack mode.', 12 pt red) is not staged. BOTTOM BAR pinned under the scroller (y 653–731.5, accent 6 % over the sheet): 'Next · timing' 15/600 white in a 44 pt accent capsule-cornered button (radius 8, 150 wide, trailing 16). Same screen on iOS: ../iOS/shapemation.builder.mode.portrait.svg (stale: drawn before the third card).

g.text: What do you want to make?
Hours become seconds, motion melts into streaks
Interval photos into a timelapse, or one long exposure
Speed rises or falls across the clip
How should the photos be laid out?
The canvas holds every photo. Each lands on top of the last, the
shape locked in place; the black table shows until it is covered.
The same stack, cropped to what every photo covers. No black
— but one off-centre shape crops everyone.
Pick the frame; the face is put at a chosen size and place in every
photo; what won't fill it is flagged.
Canvas 3274×4924 holds every photo; the shape is 398 px across.
